meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会运行一个多视角的 Mind Council 审议:根据问题挑选 4-6 个思维原型(如建筑师、逆反者、经验主义者等),让每个原型从自己的立场给出观点、风险和洞见,然后汇总共识与核心分歧,输出推荐路径和待思考的问题。
howto.when: 当你说出 'council mode'、'mind council' 等关键词,或要求多视角分析、议会/小组讨论、魔鬼代言人分析,或面临没有明显答案的困境时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 council mode 想想该不该跳槽
say.note: Claude 会召唤议会讨论这个决定

say.text: 请让几个不同原型讨论一下这个产品方案
say.note: 各原型会给出不同视角并综合建议

say.text: 用快速审议模式分析如何平衡工作和生活
say.note: Claude 会启用 3 名成员的快速审议

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude runs a multi-perspective Mind Council: it selects 4-6 thinking archetypes (such as Architect, Contrarian, Empiricist) based on the question, each presents position, reasoning, risk, and insight, then a synthesis lists convergence, core tension, and a recommended path.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'council mode', 'mind council', or ask for multi-perspective analysis, panel/board discussion, devil's advocate, or when facing a dilemma with no clear answer.

say_en.text: Help me use council mode to think about whether to change jobs.
say_en.note: Claude will summon the council to discuss the decision.

say_en.text: Ask several archetypes to discuss this product plan.
say_en.note: They give different angles and a synthesis.

say_en.text: Use quick deliberation mode to analyze work-life balance.
